name: AI Assistant
description: Floating AI assistant widget for frontend and admin panel with streaming chat, slash commands, knowledge-base grounding, and feedback.
author: MakeAI

settings.label: Enable on Frontend
settings.description: Show the assistant widget to visitors on the public site.

settings.label: Enable in Admin Panel
settings.description: Show the assistant to staff inside the admin panel.

settings.label: Auto Open on First Visit
settings.description: Opens the widget by itself once per browser session.

settings.label: Widget Position
settings.description: "Header button" replaces the floating bubble with a button in the site header. Themes without a header slot fall back to the bubble.

settings.label: Accent Color
settings.description: Used for the chat bubble, buttons and highlights.

settings.label: Hide on These Pages
settings.description: Shown on every page by default. Add one path per line to hide it, e.g. /pricing or /blog/* (a trailing * matches everything under that path). Sign-in, registration and password pages are always excluded.

settings.label: Show Home Tab
settings.description: A launcher with quick actions, recent chats and popular articles.

settings.label: Show Help Tab
settings.description: In-widget knowledge-base browser. Requires the Knowledge Base addon.

settings.label: Show "Leave a Message"
settings.description: A contact form whose submissions land in the admin messages inbox.

settings.label: Enable Slash Commands
settings.description: Lets users type / for shortcuts like /help, /usage and /docs.

settings.label: Answer from Knowledge Base
settings.description: Grounds answers in your published help articles and cites them.

settings.label: Ask for Experience Rating
settings.description: Asks the user to rate a finished conversation, once per chat.

settings.label: Allow File Upload
settings.description: Let visitors attach a file for the assistant to read. Admins can always attach.

settings.label: Allowed File Types
settings.description: Comma-separated extensions, e.g. pdf,docx,txt. Reading text from images needs a vision-capable model.

settings.label: Max Upload Size (MB)
settings.description: Largest file a user may attach, in megabytes.

settings.label: Designation
settings.description: The subtitle under the name in the widget header.

settings.label: Assistant Avatar
settings.description: Shown on the chat bubble, the header, the Home greeting and every reply. Square images work best; falls back to a robot icon.

settings.label: Greeting Message
settings.description: Leave empty to greet signed-in users by first name.

settings.label: Show Privacy/Terms Note
settings.description: Hidden automatically unless at least one link below is set.

settings.label: Privacy Policy Link
settings.description: Page slug or full URL, e.g. /privacy-policy. Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: Terms of Use Link
settings.description: Page slug or full URL, e.g. /terms. Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: Max Tokens per Reply
settings.description: Caps the length of a single answer.

settings.label: Temperature
settings.description: 0 is focused and repeatable; 1 is more creative.
